name: vision
description: High-performance, generic Computer Vision & Image Understanding MCP Tool for Styx Agent OS supporting local vision models (Moondream, Qwen2-VL, MiniCPM-V, LLaVA) and cloud APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini).

tools.name: describe_image
tools.description: Analyze an image (from a local file path, URL, or base64) and return a rich, descriptive summary of its visual contents, objects, and setting.

tools.name: inspect_image
tools.description: Ask a specific question about an image to analyze details, count objects, read charts, or identify elements.

tools.name: ocr_image
tools.description: Extract all visible text, numbers, labels, signs, or handwriting from an image.
